# Maki Kashu — Frontend Engineer Portfolio

> Personal portfolio of Maki Kashu (嘉数 真希), a Frontend Engineer based in Osaka, Japan. Born 1996. Former beauty advisor at The Ginza (3 years), turned frontend engineer after vocational web training. Worked at Dawn Inc. (2023.12 – 2025.04). Currently freelancing in frontend engineering while moonlighting as a barista. International experience in the Philippines, Australia, and the United States.
